summary: Chat Markdown lists show bullets and numbers by default, and the new `markdown` prop of AiChatProvider (also VercelAiChat and `<glirastes-chat>`) accepts remark plugins, e.g. for GFM tables.
howTo: Nothing to change. For GFM tables you can run `bun add remark-gfm` and pass `markdown={{ remarkPlugins: [remarkGfm] }}` (memoized) to AiChatProvider. If you added your own list CSS (for example `list-style` overrides) only to get markers, you can remove it.
